proposal.reason: Repair: the export returns one strict memoized function. It keeps per-instance cells for last receiver, last argument array, last result, and whether a successful call has happened. On each invocation it first snapshots the full arguments array. A cache hit requires a prior successful call, strict receiver equality, and a truthy comparator result; on hit it returns the saved result without calling resultFn. On miss it calls resultFn with the current receiver and full arguments, and only after that call returns successfully does it update cached state. If the optional comparator argument is undefined, the library uses its internal comparator: same length and per-index equality by ===, except NaN matches NaN; signed zeros still compare equal because === does.
